#!/bin/bash

echo "Keyboard Fix Log - $(date)" > "$LOG_FILE"
echo "-----------------------------------" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Function to run PowerShell commands from Bash
exec_powershell() {
    echo "Executing: $1" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    result=$(powershell.exe -Command "$1" 2>&1)
    echo "$result" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "-----------------------------------" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# 1. Disable keyboard filters (Sticky/Filter/Toggle Keys)
echo "Disabling accessibility keyboard features..." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
exec_powershell "\
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'Registry::HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags' -Value '506';\
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'Registry::HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response' -Name 'Flags' -Value '122';"

# 2. Reset keyboard repeat rates
echo "Resetting keyboard repeat rates..." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
exec_powershell "\
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'Registry::HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name 'KeyboardDelay' -Value 1;\
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'Registry::HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name 'KeyboardSpeed' -Value 31;"

# 3. Reinstall keyboard drivers
echo "Reinstalling keyboard drivers..." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
exec_powershell "\
\$device = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {\$_.Class -eq 'Keyboard'} | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty InstanceID;\
If (\$device) { pnputil /remove-device \$device };"

# 4. Reset keyboard layouts
echo "Resetting keyboard layouts..." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
exec_powershell "\
\$lang = Get-WinUserLanguageList;\
Set-WinUserLanguageList \$lang -Force;"

exec_powershell "Get-WinEvent -LogName 'System' -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object {\$_.Id -eq 27 -or \$_.Id -eq 17} | Format-List"

# 6. Final recommendations
echo -e "\n\033[1;36mTroubleshooting steps completed:\033[0m" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "1. Accessibility features disabled" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "2. Keyboard repeat rates reset" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "3. Keyboard drivers reinstalled" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "4. Input layouts refreshed" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo -e "\n\033[1;33mNext steps:\033[0m" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
